newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Reynolds, San Mig in aluminium supply deal.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds, San Mig in aluminium supply deal.

text.p: Aluminium producer Reynolds Philippines Corp said on Tuesday it had signed a 120 million peso contract with food and beverage giant San Miguel Corp for the supply of aluminium sheets.

In a disclosure to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Reynolds vice-president for sales Herman Vargas said the one-year agreement stipulates that Reynolds will supply San Miguel's metal closure lithography plant with 1,200 tonnes of aluminium closure sheets.
Reynolds started its initial public offering last February 5. The public is expected to own 34 percent of Reynold's capital after the offering ending on Tuesday.
